notes: BALANCED TWO-LINE POSTING via the engine's row-expansion ('legs') capability: each depreciation entry expands into debit depreciation expense (DOCLN 000001, DRCRK 'S') and credit accumulated depreciation (DOCLN 000002, DRCRK 'H') -- the same double-entry structure as general_ledger_lines.json, which this source couldn't express before because it has only ONE amount column per row (unlike General Ledger's paired debit/credit columns). HSL is emitted POSITIVE on both legs with the direction carried by DRCRK -- a staging convention: a real load applies signs on posting. The GL accounts (expense vs accumulated) are target-system customizing values, so RACCT is a lookup_passthrough XREF on each leg with its own lookup ref rather than a guessed account number. See depreciation_field_mapping.csv and assets_worked_example.md.
